heading: Your backups
subtitle: Local folders, external drives and NAS
emptyDescription: Add a job, select source and destination, then review the preview.
error: Unable to read application state. Retry or check access to the application data directory.
browser: Open the desktop application to access the local database. The browser only displays the interface shell.
settingsDescription: The language is saved in the application's local database.
storageDescription: Select a job to measure destination capacity
archiveDescription: Deleted and replaced versions are kept separately from the active mirror
saveError: Unable to save language. Please retry.
name: Job name
sourceHelp: Select a readable folder. Root, home and system directories are protected. Links and junctions are rejected.
networkHelp: Enter a UNC path or browse an accessible network folder. Save NAS access below to reconnect automatically after a reboot. Share identity is checked before changes.
localHelp: Select an existing folder on a local or attached volume. A NAS connection is not required.
managedHelp: New jobs copy directly into the selected empty folder. Archive and safety metadata live in .nas-backup-manager and are excluded from mirroring. Existing jobs keep their previous layout.
skip: Skip until the next scheduled time
retentionHelp: Deleted and replaced copies expire after this number of days. Expiry cleanup permanently removes only verified expired versions.
reviewHelp: Saving creates service folders. The first run requires preview approval. A selected recurrence enables automatically after a successful approved run. Disable the schedule before editing.
removeConfirm: Remove this job and its OS schedule? Backup files and archives remain on disk; the archive remains available for restore.
consent: I have reviewed this plan and approve copying, replacing and archiving these files.
massDeletion: The deletion count has reached this job’s protection threshold. Check the source and confirm this plan manually.
databaseWarning: Database files found: ordinary file copies may be inconsistent while an application is writing. No application-consistent snapshot is provided.
cleanupConfirm: Permanently remove verified expired archive files? Active backups and unexpired versions are preserved.
noArchive: No archived files on this page
scheduleHelp: Schedules run with the UI closed. On Windows your user must be signed in. Sleep is not prevented. Computer wake is configured per job. Shares must be accessible in the scheduled user session. Moving this app folder requires re-registering schedules.
scheduleConsent: Enable automatic backups and expiry cleanup for this job using its approved configuration?
retentionHint: Archive versions eventually expire. Existing expiration dates remain unchanged when retention is edited.

errors.cancelled: Synchronization cancelled by the user. Completed copies were preserved.
errors.interrupted: The previous synchronization was interrupted when the application or PC stopped. Create a new preview and run synchronization again.
errors.filesystem: Cannot access a file or folder. Check the connection, free space and permissions; close applications locking files, then preview again.
errors.overlap: Source/destination trees overlap with this or another job. Choose isolated folders.
errors.protected_directory: Root, home and system directories cannot be selected. Choose a specific data folder.
errors.absolute_path_required: Enter an absolute existing folder path.
errors.identity_mismatch: The expected drive/share or managed folder has changed. Reconnect the correct destination; no destructive operation is allowed.
errors.ownership_mismatch: Ownership marker mismatch. Reconnect the correct destination.
errors.link_not_supported: A symlink or junction was found. Select a folder without links.
errors.invalid_job: Check name, paths, time, integer interval and retention of at least one day.
errors.stale_job: The job was edited elsewhere. Refresh and try again.
errors.paths_immutable: Create a separate job to change source or destination. Existing archives remain with their original job.
errors.disable_schedule_first: Disable this job’s schedule before editing or removing it.
errors.busy: The job is already running in another process. Wait for it to finish.
errors.database: The local database is unavailable or busy. Retry after the current operation.
errors.stale_preview: Files have changed and will be updated on the next synchronization. Refresh the preview to run now.
errors.preview_required: Run and approve a successful preview first.
errors.consent_required: Review the plan and explicitly approve it.
errors.restore_collision: A destination file already exists. It has not been overwritten. Restore to a different path or resolve the collision first.
errors.integrity_failed: Integrity verification failed. Existing valid copies have been preserved.
errors.mass_deletion: Automatic run stopped: suspicious mass deletion. Check the source and approve a fresh manual preview.
errors.file_changed_during_copy: Files have changed and will be updated on the next synchronization. Refresh the preview to run now.
errors.successful_run_required: Cleanup requires the most recent backup run to have completed successfully.
errors.archive_requires_preservation: This job still has protected archive versions. Pause it; keep it available for restore.
errors.scheduler_cli_missing: Headless executable is missing beside the app. Restore nas-backup.exe and enable the schedule again.
errors.scheduler_registration_failed: The OS rejected schedule registration. Check Task Scheduler/service availability and user permissions.
errors.scheduler_unavailable: OS scheduler unavailable. Linux requires an available systemd user session; use an external scheduler invoking the documented CLI otherwise.
errors.path_type_conflict: A file conflicts with a folder at the same relative path. Resolve it and preview again.
errors.worker_failed: Operation interrupted. Check history and create a new preview.
errors.database_unavailable: Cannot open the local application database.
errors.non_unicode_path: This folder path cannot be represented safely in the interface. Choose a Unicode path.
errors.next_run_unavailable: This OS adapter does not expose the next actual run time.
errors.destination_type_mismatch: Destination type does not match the mounted folder. For NAS choose an accessible UNC share or mounted network folder; for an ordinary drive choose Local folder.
errors.mount_identity_unavailable: The network mount identity cannot be safely established on this OS. The operation is blocked.
errors.destination_not_empty: Choose an empty destination for a new job. Existing unrelated files cannot be adopted automatically.
errors.reserved_backup_path: The source contains the reserved name .nas-backup-manager. Rename it; this directory protects backup metadata and archives.
errors.network_unc_required: Enter a UNC path such as \\server\share\folder. A mapped drive letter cannot be used for automatic connection.
errors.network_auth_failed: The NAS rejected the username or password. Check credentials and permissions.
errors.network_credential_conflict: Windows is connected to this server with another account. Close the conflicting connection yourself or use the same account. The app never disconnects other sessions.
errors.network_unavailable: The network share is unavailable. Check NAS power, network and share name.
errors.network_connection_timeout: NAS connection exceeded 30 seconds. Check the network and retry.
errors.network_helper_unavailable: Unable to access Windows network or credential APIs. Check PowerShell policies and user access.
errors.network_credentials_missing: No credentials saved for this share.
errors.network_credentials_invalid: Enter the NAS username and password.
errors.network_credentials_unsupported: In-app credential configuration is available on Windows. Use OS-managed secure credentials and mounts on this platform.
errors.network_guest_blocked: Windows blocked guest access by security policy. Configure an authenticated NAS account or review the guest SMB policy. The app does not change Windows security settings.
errors.network_guest_rejected: The NAS rejected password-free guest access. Enable guest access on the NAS or select an authenticated account.
errors.link_open_failed: Could not open the browser. Visit github.com/redn1ghtz or github.com/redn1ghtz/NAS_Backup_Manager.
errors.wake_unsupported: Application-controlled wake is currently supported only on Windows.
errors.manual_schedule: This job runs manually only. Automatic scheduling and wake are disabled. Choose a recurrence in job settings to enable them.
errors.notification_unavailable: Windows could not show a notification. Check notification permissions in Windows Settings. The backup result is unchanged.

restoreConfirm: A destination file exists. Archive it and replace it with the selected version?
keepDays: Keep for a number of days
noArchiveWarning: Deleted and replaced copies will be permanently removed without archive recovery. Existing archives keep their original expiration dates.
noArchiveConsent: I understand that deleted and replaced copies will be removed without archiving and approve this plan.
scheduleAnchorHelp: Day intervals start on the date the job is saved. Minute and hour intervals start about one minute after enabling the schedule; missed runs do not accumulate.
backupAttention: Some jobs have errors — check history
backupWaiting: Add a job or run the first backup
archiveCountHelp: Total verified versions, including replaced files
helpText: Add a job: choose a source and isolated destination folder, configure the schedule and archive policy. After saving, review the preview and approve the first backup. Enable the schedule to run with the window closed. External drives and network shares must be connected; on Windows the user must remain signed in. New jobs copy directly into the selected empty folder. Archive and safety metadata live in .nas-backup-manager and are excluded from mirroring. Existing jobs keep their previous layout.
aboutText: Free, open-source application. MIT license. No activation, artificial transfer speed caps or telemetry. Third-party terms are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md beside the application.
networkAccessHelp: Choose a connection mode. Opening Explorer before a backup is unnecessary. Passwords and guest preferences are stored per share in the current user’s Windows vault. Use a UNC path such as \\server\share\folder. The Windows user must be signed in.
networkAccessSaved: Credentials saved in Windows for this share.
networkAccessMissing: No app credentials saved. Available Windows credentials will be used.
networkGuestHelp: No password is needed. A new connection uses guest with an empty password. Both NAS and Windows must allow this access. Connection and permissions are checked during preview and execution.
networkGuestSaved: Guest mode saved for this share, including scheduled runs. The connection will be checked during preview or execution.
networkWindowsSaved: Automatic Windows mode is in use. No app credentials are saved for this share.
deletionGuardHelp: Automatic runs stop when the deletion count reaches this number. The proportion of files is not considered. Review and confirm the deletion manually in preview.
deletionGuardOff: Protection is disabled. Automatic runs can delete any number of files. Source and destination availability checks remain mandatory.
author: Author
wakeHelp: Windows can wake the PC from sleep or hibernation for this task. Hardware support and enabled wake timers are required. The user must remain signed in. This does not power on a shut-down PC.
wakeUnsupported: Application-controlled wake is currently supported only on Windows.
manualScheduleHelp: This job runs manually only. Automatic scheduling and wake are disabled. Choose a recurrence in job settings to enable them.
autoScheduleHelp: The schedule enables automatically after a successful synchronization of the approved preview. You can then close the interface.
autoScheduleConsent: After successful completion, enable the selected schedule, including its deletion and archive cleanup rules.
scheduleActivationFailed: Synchronization completed, but the schedule could not be enabled.
notificationsHelp: Notify when synchronization starts, finishes or fails. Tray status and progress remain visible independently of this setting.
sourceChanged: Files have changed and will be updated on the next synchronization. Refresh the preview to run now.
startupHelp: Windows: runs 30 seconds after you sign in, including after starting the computer. The interface can remain closed. The computer and NAS must be available. This is not a wake-from-sleep trigger.
progressWorkHint: Overall progress of copying and verification. 100% requires successful completion.
storagePending: Storage capacity is not available yet
cancelledHint: Synchronization cancelled. Completed copies were preserved; the schedule is unchanged.
cancelSyncHelp: Stop the current synchronization. Completed copies are preserved. Current archiving and system I/O may need time to stop safely.
